notes:
Teacher 1.20.10, console 2.3.28, teacher laptop 1.0.0.
- Installs on Android 7.0 and newer (1.20.9 required Android 8 and was rejected as an invalid package on older phones)
- APK now carries both the v2 and v3 signatures, so strict phone installers accept it
- Classes open the way teachers know them: your class list, then the learners, then their marks
- A teacher is never left with an empty app: unmatched phones see the school's classes with a clear banner and Find my classes
- Learners still appear after a class is recreated for a new year
- Sending marks works without a cloud account (file/WhatsApp bundle for the head teacher)
